# acli-py sprint

Plan, start and close sprints.


## `acli-py sprint list`

List a board's sprints.

```text
acli-py sprint list [BOARD] [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BOARD` |  | Board id (default: config). |
| `-s`, `--state` `TEXT` |  | future, active or closed (repeatable). |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |


## `acli-py sprint view`

Show a sprint.

```text
acli-py sprint view SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py sprint create`

Create a future sprint on a board.

```text
acli-py sprint create [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` `TEXT` | required | Sprint name. |
| `-b`, `--board` `INTEGER` |  | Board id (default: `acli-py config set board`). |
| `--start` `TEXT` |  | Start: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `--end` `TEXT` |  | End: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `-g`, `--goal` `TEXT` |  | Sprint goal. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py sprint update`

Rename a sprint or change its dates or goal.

```text
acli-py sprint update SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `--name` `TEXT` |  | Sprint name. |
| `--start` `TEXT` |  | Start: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `--end` `TEXT` |  | End: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `-g`, `--goal` `TEXT` |  | Sprint goal. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint start`

Start a future sprint (now, for --weeks, unless dates are given).

```text
acli-py sprint start SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `--start` `TEXT` |  | Start: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `--end` `TEXT` |  | End: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `--weeks` `INTEGER` | `2` | Length when no --end is given. |
| `-g`, `--goal` `TEXT` |  | Sprint goal. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint close`

Complete an active sprint. Unfinished issues go back to the backlog.

```text
acli-py sprint close SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint delete`

Delete sprints; their issues move to the backlog.

```text
acli-py sprint delete SPRINTS [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINTS` | required | Sprint ids. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors`, `--continue-on-error` |  | Keep going when an issue fails (else stop starting new ones); exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint issues`

List the issues in a sprint.

```text
acli-py sprint issues SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL or smart query finds. |
| `--fields` `TEXT` |  | Columns, comma-separated: key,status,assignee,summary… or field ids (customfield_10016). |
| `--format` `TEXT` |  | One line per issue from a template: '{key}\t{status}\t{summary}'. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |


## `acli-py sprint report`

How a sprint is going: its issues by status and by assignee, and how much is done.

```text
acli-py sprint report [SPRINT] [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py sprint report --board 1
acli-py sprint report 7 --output markdown
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` |  | Sprint id (default: the board's active sprint). |
| `-b`, `--board` `INTEGER` |  | Board id (default: `acli-py config set board`). |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |


## `acli-py sprint add`

Move issues into a sprint.

```text
acli-py sprint add SPRINT [KEYS] [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py sprint add 8 DEMO-1 DEMO-2
acli-py issue search 'p:DEMO is:open #web' --output keys | acli-py sprint add 8 -
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `KEYS` |  | Issue keys (DEMO-1 DEMO-2, or DEMO-1,DEMO-2); '-' reads keys or JSON lines from stdin. |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL or smart query finds. |
| `--filter` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues of this saved filter id. |
| `-f`, `--from-file` `PATH` |  | Read issue keys from a file (commas, spaces or lines; '-' for stdin). |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` |  | Act on at most this many issues. |
| `-c`, `--concurrency` `INTEGER` | `4` | How many issues to work on at once. |
| `--ignore-errors`, `--continue-on-error` |  | Keep going when an issue fails (else stop starting new ones); exit 1 at the end. |
| `--force` |  | Allow acting on more than 200 issues at once. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
